idea-plugin.name: Iris Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Iris is a carefully tuned light and dark theme for JetBrains IDEs, including WebStorm.

It brings the Iris palette from T3 Code to the IntelliJ Platform with matching UI colors, editor schemes, console colors, syntax highlighting, tabs, tool windows, lists, popups, inputs, status bars, version-control states, and a custom icon.

The Iris palette is used under the MIT License. This plugin is independent and is not affiliated with T3 Tools or JetBrains.
